---
# =============================================================================
# CANONICAL WORKSHEET TEMPLATE
#
# Copy to worksheets/<ws_id>.qmd and fill in from docs/worksheets/<ws_id>.md.
# This template is excluded from the render list, so it is never published.
#
# Every placeholder is marked <<LIKE THIS>>. A render that still contains "<<"
# anywhere FAILS the layout gate. That is deliberate.
#
# Three rules that this file exists to encode. All three were learned the hard
# way; breaking any of them produces a page that looks fine in source and is
# broken in the render:
#
#   1. The body is RAW HTML inside one ```{=html} block. Never Pandoc fenced
#      divs (::: {.class}). A closing fence that follows a block-level HTML tag
#      is absorbed into that tag and the page silently mis-nests.
#
#   2. Geometry uses the `html:root` selector, not `:root`. Quarto injects
#      include-in-header BEFORE the project stylesheet, so a plain :root
#      override has equal specificity and LOSES on source order — the sheet
#      then renders at the stylesheet default and the print clips.
#
#   3. Every <col> width is a PERCENT and they sum to 100. Quarto's table
#      filter drops mm/px col widths, sums the percentages it kept, and writes
#      that onto the table as an inline width. Mixed units give a half-width
#      table.
# =============================================================================

title: "<<Worksheet title — the spec's H1, verbatim>>"
pagetitle: "<<ws_id>>"

format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>
            /* Copy the exact pair for your declared format from
               .github/skills/worksheet-build/SKILL.md § Page geometry.
               These two lines must agree or the print clips. */
            html:root { --sheet-w: 420mm; --sheet-h: 297mm; --sheet-margin: 12mm; }
            @page { size: A3 landscape; margin: 12mm; }
          </style>
---

```{=html}
<div class="screen-only">
  <b><<ws_id>></b> &middot; review copy &middot; declared format <b><<A3 landscape>></b> &middot;
  <<N>> sheet(s). Each white page below is one physical sheet at true size.
  Anything spilling past a page edge onto this grey background is a layout defect.
</div>

<!-- ============================ SHEET 1 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1><<Worksheet title>></h1>
      <p class="ws-sub"><<Spec §1 "Output artifact", one line — what this sheet produces>></p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b><<ws_id>></b><br>
      <<Pack X - name>><br>
      fill order <b><<n>></b> &middot; type <b><<type>></b><br>
      audience <b><<audience>></b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b><<Chapter title>></b>, <i><<Heading>></i> &middot;
    <code><<handbook/chNN-slug.qmd>></code> <<L18-41>> &middot;
    <a href="<<published URL from spec §2>>"><<#sec-stable-anchor>></a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    <<Spec §4 "What the user fills", rewritten as a direct instruction TO the
    person holding the pen. Second person. No commentary about the book.>>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2><<Block name>>
      <span class="ws-block-note"><<one per team / one row per component>></span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <!-- PERCENTAGES ONLY, SUMMING TO 100 -->
        <col style="width:6%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:36%"><col style="width:36%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Field</th><th>What the book says</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>

        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b><<Field name, verbatim from spec §5 column "Field">></b></td>
          <td class="prior"><<Spec §5 "Pre-filled from the book". Em dash if that column is "—".>>
            <span class="prior-src"><<ch07 L98>></span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>

        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b><<Field name>></b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill">
            <div class="f-select">
              <span class="opt"><<option one>></span>
              <span class="opt"><<option two>></span>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>

      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <!-- Only where spec §10 lists a hedged figure reachable from this range.
       The figure and the book's own hedge are ONE unit: never split them,
       never paraphrase the hedge, never print the figure in a column header
       or beside a blank cell without this wrapper. -->
  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2><<Block name>></h2>

    <div class="prior--hedged">
      <span class="hedge-figure"><<The figure, exactly as the book states it>></span>
      <span class="hedge-text"><<The book's hedge, VERBATIM from spec §10 — copy it, never rewrite it>></span>
      <span class="hedge-src"><<handbook/chNN-....qmd LNN>></span>
    </div>

    <div class="ours-label"><<Our number — measured here, dated>></div>
    <span class="f-text"></span>
  </div>

  <!-- Where the spec calls for the chapter's own sentence at the foot. -->
  <div class="ws-foot-quote">
    <<The book's sentence, verbatim, with its (chNN LNN) reference>>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div><<ws_id>> &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 1 of <<N>></div>
    <div>Filled by <span style="display:inline-block;width:40mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span>
      &nbsp; Date <span style="display:inline-block;width:24mm;border-bottom:.25mm solid #93a0ad"></span></div>
  </div>

</div>
<!-- ========================== END SHEET 1 ============================ -->
```
